title: Packet Verdict
description: A verdict scoring a context packet against the five criteria the distribution pilot's test two proved discriminable at the nano tier: self-containment, machine-checkable goal conditions, lane boundaries, resolvable citations, output contract. Produced by judging-a-context-packet; never a seating record and never a routing decision — a verdict says how a packet scored, not what becomes of it.
$comment: Seated per decision record rejudge-the-distribution-pilot (option 3, continue narrowly) and requirement route-work-by-measured-complexity-across-inference-tiers, cell skill:judging-a-context-packet-is-a-fueled-inquiry. total and verdict are computed by the actuating script from the five criteria scores (total = their sum; verdict = a threshold band over total) and are NOT enforced as consistent with criteria by this schema — JSON Schema has no keyword for 'field X equals a function of fields Y', and this pool's validator implements a stated subset of 2020-12 rather than a private extension, so no custom keyword is invented here. A hand-built record bypassing the actuating script could carry a total/verdict inconsistent with its criteria and still validate; the invariant is held by the script that assembles the record, named here so the gap is on the record rather than silently assumed closed.

packet-label.description: Caller-given (--label) or derived from the packet's own id/name/slug; never silently defaulted onto disk — the actuating script refuses to write a verdict under the untitled-packet fallback to --verdict-dir, to avoid two unlabeled packets overwriting one another.

criteria.description: Exactly the five criteria test two proved discriminable. A sixth key is refused, not ignored.

total.description: Computed by the actuating script as the sum of the five criteria scores; never requested from the model.

verdict.$comment: PROVISIONAL, UNEVIDENCED band cutoffs, computed by the actuating script from total: total >= 8 -> strong, 4 <= total <= 7 -> adequate, total <= 3 -> deficient (a missing or non-numeric score yields a NaN total, which fails both >= comparisons and falls through to deficient by construction). The distribution pilot's test two (2026-07-16) produced only total = 10 (the real packet, all five scores 2) and total = 0 (the deficient control, all five scores 0); it never exercised the middle band or these exact cutoffs. Revise once production packets accumulate evidence for where the bands should actually sit.
